episode_wall_cap_note: grader safety net, not a budget (amendment 1): 2400 s program time + 1500 s simulated at up to 1.4 s of the cell's wall each (measured 0.72-0.85 on one CPU) + 600 frames at up to 0.5 s each (measured 0.25-0.27); an episode inside every documented budget does not reach it
note: the grader's cell configuration; cell_config.json in the payload is this file minus the grader-only keys (runner_account, socket_sample_s). program_time_cap_s caps the program's own time per episode: the wall clock minus the cell's simulation (step) and rendering (get_camera), which the sim cap and the frame budget bound (cellkit.wire); cpu_cap_factor x program_time_cap_s = the program's CPU seconds
